name: Greenbelt (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, the white charged with a lone green pine tree.
history: Greenbelt is a city in Prince George's County, Maryland, and a suburb of Washington, D.C. At the 2020 census, the population was 24,921. The flag was adopted in 1938 (the design by Mary Clare Bonham, a high-school junior, won a competition of 65 entrants and was first flown at a city celebration on 4 July 1938, according to Flags of the World).
